user.title: Choose your Xiaomi cloud region
user.description: Pick the region your Xiaomi account is registered in. Europe and the UK use the Germany (DE) server. Choosing the wrong region means your vacuum won't be found.

data_description.cloud_country: The Mi Home cloud server that hosts your account.

qr.title: Scan with the Mi Home app
qr.description:
![QR]({qr_image})

Open the Mi Home app, tap the QR scanner (top-right corner), and scan the code. The dialog will advance automatically once you confirm on the phone.

qr_failed.title: QR not scanned in time
qr_failed.description: The QR code expired before you scanned it. Submit to generate a new one.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to Xiaomi cloud
reauth_confirm.description: The Xiaomi cloud session expired, so the cleaning map stopped updating. Submit to show a new QR code and sign in again — the vacuum and its other entities keep working in the meantime.

reconfigure.title: Change the Xiaomi cloud region
reconfigure.description: Pick the region your Xiaomi account is registered in. The current cloud session is reused, so no new QR scan is needed. If the region is wrong the vacuum won't be found.

data_description.cloud_country: The Mi Home cloud server that hosts your account.

discover.title: Pick your vacuum
discover.description: More than one vacuum was found in your account. Choose the one to add.

progress.waiting_for_scan:
![QR]({qr_image})

Open the Mi Home app, tap the QR scanner (top-right corner), and scan the code. The dialog will advance automatically once you confirm on the phone.

error.qr_not_scanned: QR was not scanned in time. A new code is shown — try again.

abort.no_vacuum_found: No vacuum was found in this Xiaomi account. Make sure it's paired in the Mi Home app and try again.
abort.no_vacuum_in_account: This Xiaomi account has devices, but none of them is a supported vacuum. The Xiaomi cloud region must match the one your Mi Home account uses — reconfigure and pick the correct region, or pair the vacuum to this account in the Mi Home app.
abort.cloud_list_failed: Could not list devices in your Xiaomi account. Try again later.
abort.no_local_ip: Xiaomi cloud did not return a local IP for this vacuum. Make sure it's online and connected to the same Wi-Fi as Home Assistant.
abort.local_unreachable: The vacuum was found in the cloud but Home Assistant cannot reach it on the LAN. Check it's on the same network and online.
abort.local_probe_failed: Local probe failed unexpectedly. See logs.
abort.reauth_successful: Xiaomi cloud session refreshed. The cleaning map will start updating again.
abort.reauth_failed: Could not refresh the Xiaomi cloud session. Try again.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Region updated. The vacuum now uses the selected Xiaomi cloud server.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The vacuum found in that region is a different device than this entry. Region unchanged.

cannot_connect.title: Cannot reach {name}
cannot_connect.description: Home Assistant cannot connect to the vacuum at {host}. The robot is likely powered off or disconnected from the network. Its entities show as unavailable and the map keeps the last known image until it reconnects. This issue clears automatically once the vacuum is back online.

unsupported_model.title: {name} is an unsupported model
unsupported_model.description: The vacuum reports model `{model}`, which this integration does not yet know about. It fell back to a best-effort spec so basic local control keeps working, but some entities (status, fault, capabilities) may be wrong or missing. Please open an issue on the project's GitHub page with this model name so support can be added.

mop_mode_requires_pad.message: Cannot select a mop mode: no mop pad detected. Attach the mop pad to the vacuum and try again.

send_command_params_unsupported.message: The command {command} does not accept parameters.
